audience: businesses using SMS Everyone for reminders, alerts and customer messages

useCases.title: Check credits before sending
useCases.text: Read the account balance and its Unicode and international messaging settings before planning a message.

useCases.title: Follow campaign progress and delivery
useCases.text: Check a campaign’s lifecycle status, then inspect delivery receipts for the campaign or a selected destination. Missing receipts do not prove delivery.

useCases.title: Review recent customer replies
useCases.text: Read replies for a recent period or date range and page through the results while preserving their unread status.

useCases.title: Send a confirmed reminder or alert
useCases.text: Review the message, registered sender and up to 25 explicit recipient numbers, then confirm an immediate or scheduled send using the account’s SMS credits.

useCases.title: Record customer opt-outs
useCases.text: Read existing opt-outs, then confirm which numbers to add so future messages from the account exclude them.
